title: Shri Surya Ashtakam
intro: Shri Surya Ashtakam is a powerful and vibrant eight-verse hymn dedicated to Lord Surya (The Sun God). Regular recitation of this stotram is believed to bestow good health, vitality, clarity of mind, and divine radiance, especially when chanted during sunrise.
description:
॥ Shri Suryashtakam ॥

Adideva Namastubhyam
Prasida Mama Bhaskara |
Divakara Namastubhyam
Prabhakara Namostute ||1||

Saptashvarathamarudham
Prachandam Kashyapatmajam |
Shwetapadmadharam Devam Tam
Suryam Pranamamyaham ||2||

Lohitam Rathamarudham
Sarvalokapitamaham |
Mahapapaharam Devam Tam
Suryam Pranamamyaham ||3||

Traigunyam Cha Mahashuram
Brahmavishnumaheshvaram |
Mahapapaharam Devam Tam
Suryam Pranamamyaham ||4||

Brimhitam Tejapunjam Cha
Vayumakashameva Cha |
Prabhum Cha Sarvalokanam
Tam Suryam Pranamamyaham ||5||

Bandhukapushpasankasham
Harakundalabhushitam |
Ekachakradharam Devam
Tam Suryam Pranamamyaham ||6||

Tam Suryam Jagatkartaram
Mahatejahpradiapanam |
Mahapapaharam Devam
Tam Suryam Pranamamyaham ||7||

Tam Suryam Jagatam Nathan
Gyanavignanamokshadam |
Mahapapaharam Devam
Tam Suryam Pranamamyaham ||8||

॥ Iti Shri Shivaprokta Suryashtakam Sampoornam ॥

faq.a1: It is a sacred eight-verse hymn dedicated to Lord Surya (The Sun God), glorifying His divine radiance, forms, and cosmic power.
faq.q2: What is the origin or source of Surya Ashtakam?
faq.a2: As indicated in the concluding line (Shivaprokta), this stotram is revealed or spoken by Lord Shiva, originating from traditional scriptural texts.
faq.q3: What are the benefits of reciting Surya Ashtakam?
faq.a3: Regular recitation is believed to destroy great sins, bestow good health (arogya), physical and spiritual brilliance (tejas), supreme knowledge, and ultimate liberation (moksha).
faq.q4: When is the best time to recite Surya Ashtakam?
faq.a4: It is best recited during sunrise, facing east, preferably after taking a bath, to harness the vital energy and blessings of the Sun God.
